# Office.com

> Microsoft 365's unified hub for AI-powered productivity, document creation, and seamless collaboration across Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.

Office.com serves as the central destination for Microsoft 365 users to access cloud-based productivity tools enhanced with AI Copilot capabilities. The platform supports global users across multiple languages and regions with localized experiences.

## Key Topics

- Microsoft 365
- Microsoft 365 Copilot
- AI productivity tools
- Document creation
- Create, share, and collaborate
- Word
- Excel
- PowerPoint
- Outlook
- Office apps integration
- Email assistant
- Localization
- International markets
- Regional variants
- Cloud collaboration

## Core Platform

- [Microsoft 365 Copilot | Create, Share and Collaborate](https://www.office.com): Microsoft 365 hub featuring AI Copilot for creating, sharing, and collaborating with integrated Office apps and AI-powered productivity tools.

## Regional & Localization

- [Office.com Worldwide](https://store.office.com/worldwide.aspx): Language and region selection page for Office.com across international markets with country-specific and regional variant support.
